items.hed: Rockets host Oklahoma City tonight after a 116-111 loss in Dallas
items.insight: The NBA schedule lists Oklahoma City at Toyota Center tonight, Saturday, Oct. 31, at 8:30 p.m. ET. Houston comes in 5-1 after Friday's Emirates NBA Cup game in Dallas, a 116-111 Mavericks win at American Airlines Center. No tip result is posted at this edition, so none is printed here.

items.hed: Texans are on their Week 8 bye, then go to the Chargers on Nov. 8
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Week 8, the weekend of Nov. 1, as the bye. Next is Week 9, Sunday, Nov. 8, at the Los Angeles Chargers, SoFi Stadium, 3:05 p.m. CT on CBS. Then come Cleveland on Nov. 15 and a Thursday night home game against Indianapolis on Nov. 19 on Prime Video.

items.hed: Six Astros elected free agency on Oct. 29, including Abreu and Varsho
items.insight: MLB.com's Astros transactions page lists six players electing free agency on Oct. 29: right-hander Bryan Abreu, center fielder Daulton Varsho, catcher Christian Vázquez, first baseman LaMonte Wade Jr., right-hander Enyel De Los Santos, and left-hander Steven Okert. Two days earlier, Houston released left fielder Nelson Velázquez.
